reviews.decision_reason: Given the exact needs handoff it received, map_coverage retained the eight allowed record_ids, preserved record_id and need in coverage, and consistently marked no direct capability coverage because the handed-off need values were source ids rather than capability need text. The upstream corruption is not introduced here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Map capabilities to needs without changing the stipulated need text.
Select every qualifying demand row and preserve downstream coverage record_id and need from the handoff.

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize preserved all eight coverage rows, joined upstream ranks from the evidence_sources handoff, marked all rows unsupported, and ordered them by unsupported status then upstream rank 1 through 8.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Preserve exact upstream-to-downstream handoffs for provenance ranking.
Order unsupported needs first and otherwise preserve upstream ranking.

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize retained the eight ranked priorities and built the recommendation directly from the first ranked row, yielding decision prioritize and top_need s01 as required by the actual ranked input.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Produce the deterministic top-need recommendation and decision required by the execution contract.

reviews.decision_reason: Top root cause: select_demand selected all eight qualifying corpus rows, but it did not preserve the stipulated corpus need field. It wrote need from source_id, converting the original need text into s01 through s08 before the handoff.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight fields.
Map capabilities to needs without changing the stipulated need text.

reviews.decision_reason: normalize preserved the selected rows it received, enforced the required columns, retained the allowed record_ids, and bounded the output to eight rows. The need values were already corrupted before this boundary.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Preserve allowed corpus identifiers and required columns in normalized needs.
Bound normalized needs to the declared eight-row window.

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance produced eight evidence_source rows with record_id, source_id, source_weight, and deterministic rank ordered by demand_score descending and record_id tie-break, matching the observed handoff.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Assemble ranked source provenance with deterministic ordering.
